Hi Samira / Arjun — thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:  

- What we heard: Clearline is evaluating inference throughput for batch clinical summarization and needs predictable latency under bursty nightly loads; security and auditability are gating items for procurement.
- Key stakeholders you mentioned: Samira (product), Arjun (platform/infra), plus legal/security later in the cycle.

Proposal: schedule an initial 30-minute product demo that covers: 1) short product tour (10m), 2) representative performance profile on comparable workloads (10m), 3) next steps & stakeholder owners (10m).  

I can make any of these windows:
- Option A: Thu Oct 8 — 9:00–9:30am PT (Samira, Arjun)
- Option B: Thu Oct 8 — 1:00–1:30pm PT (Samira + technical lead)
- Option C: Fri Oct 9 — 11:00–11:30am PT (exec-friendly; backup)

Please pick the option that works best and confirm who from your side will join for the technical portion. If none of the above work, share two slots that do. I attached a short one-pager and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) for visibility.

Action items for Clearline: confirm preferred slot + technical owner (name/email)
Action items for Redwood: lock invite, include Priyom (solutions engineer) on the tech portion, provide perf examples in follow-up.

Thanks — happy to adjust cadence if you'd prefer a 45-minute technical run-through instead.

Best,
